page_title: REN 1-4 PSG | Rennes v PSG 08/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Mathieu Vernice is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Achraf Hakimi (PSG) was quite harsh and Mathieu Vernice didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+5' Referee Mathieu Vernice sees the trip by Senny Mayulu (PSG) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Free kick. Rennes will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
90+4' 1 - 4 Ousmane Dembele (PSG) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
90+1' 1 - 3 Goal! Achraf Hakimi puts the ball across the area and Ousmane Dembele (PSG) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 1:3.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
87' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is free in the box and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia finds him with a pass, but his powerful shot skims just past the right post. Good chance!
85' Kyogo Furuhashi (Rennes) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
84' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
83' Habib Beye has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mousa Tamari (Rennes) replacing Ludovic Blas.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mohamed Meite leaves the pitch and Kyogo Furuhashi (Rennes) comes on.
79' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
77' The current number of shots on goal is 2:7.
74' Matvey Safonov leaps to intercept the corner kick from Ludovic Blas (Rennes).
74' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Bradley Barcola will be replaced by Achraf Hakimi (PSG).
73' Mohamed Meite (Rennes) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
72' A substitution has been made. Jordan James goes off and Seko Fofana (Rennes) comes on.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Azor Matusiwa (Rennes) comes onto the pitch for Ismael Kone.
71' Anthony Rouault (Rennes) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
68' Looks like Lilian Brassier (Rennes) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
67' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) tries to threaten the goalkeeper as he takes the ball and fires from long range. The shot flies just over the crossbar!
65' Here's the change. Joao Neves leaves the pitch and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) comes on as a substitute.
64' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Kang-In Lee is replaced by Vitinha (PSG).
64' Here comes a substitution. Goncalo Ramos is given a rest as he is replaced by Ousmane Dembele (PSG).
64' The manager makes a subsitution with Nuno Mendes (PSG) coming on for Lucas Hernandez.
63' Ismael Kone (Rennes) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
61' The percentage of ball possession is – 28:72.
59' Mohamed Meite (Rennes) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar.
58' PSG keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
58' Yellow card. Anthony Rouault (Rennes) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
56' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
53' 1 - 2 Goal! Jeremy Jacquet gets up really well from the corner and heads the ball into the six-yard box where Lilian Brassier (Rennes) glances a header into the net. 1:2.
52' There's an opportunity for Ludovic Blas (Rennes) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
50' 0 - 2 Referee Mathieu Vernice points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Goncalo Ramos (PSG) goes wild in celebration.
50' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Mathieu Vernice is going to take a look using VAR.
50' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Goncalo Ramos (PSG) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
48' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.

47' Bradley Barcola sprays a wonderful pass out to Senny Mayulu (PSG), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Brice Samba problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the right post.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Bradley Barcola (PSG) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
45+1' Mohamed Meite (Rennes) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The ball is cleared after Bradley Barcola (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
44' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 3:8.
41' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
41' Mohamed Meite (Rennes) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the crossbar!
40' Bradley Barcola (PSG) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
39' Kang-In Lee (PSG) tricks his way to edge of the area and unleashes a howitzer of a shot towards the inside the left post, but Brice Samba earns his money with a fine reflex save.
36' The game is interrupted. Lucas Hernandez (PSG) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
34' Brice Samba (Rennes) has tested the patience of referee Mathieu Vernice and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
33' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Desire Doue (PSG) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
31' Bradley Barcola (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
29' 0:3 – this is the current number of shots on target.
27' 0 - 1 Bradley Barcola (PSG) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Brice Samba with a strike into the right side of the goal. He makes it 0:1.

27' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Brice Samba guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
25' Desire Doue (PSG) sends a cross into the box, but Brice Samba comes off his line to gather the ball.
25' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
24' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Lucas Hernandez (PSG).
22' The ball possession at the moment is 12:88.
19' Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.

16' Bradley Barcola (PSG) unleashes a promising shot towards the right side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Brice Samba thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
14' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
14' The referee signals a corner kick to PSG.
12' Bradley Barcola (PSG) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
10' Kang-In Lee (PSG) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
10' Senny Mayulu (PSG) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
8' PSG are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
6' Bradley Barcola (PSG) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
5' Jordan James (Rennes) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
3' Desire Doue (PSG) and Bradley Barcola attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Rennes will kick the game off.
Mathieu Vernice is introduced as the referee for today's match.
